_help: Chat window (official UI/StatusBar3.img/chat art). Game pixels in 1366x768. x,y = the window top-left. The tab row sits on top, the log frame under it, the input line at the bottom. logPadX/logPadY = the gap from the frame edge to the text. lineH = the height of one log line. btnW/btnGap = the five input buttons on the right of the input line.
